Hello,

did anyone try anything of the sort ? I'd like to hold a non-official
tournament on this theme. I thought of rules like :
- no "modern" equipement can be used ;
- there is no Sabbat, no Camarilla : all titles with 1, 2 or 3 votes allow
to play all the corresponding cards (i.e. Prince, Archbishop or 2 Votes can
all use Parity Shift or 2nd Tradition), and Inner Circles either don't exist
or can be played by either ;
- Locations or other cards concerning Sabbat, Camarilla or Independents
either are not allowed or playable by all
- no vampire under 4 is allowed

Ideas, comments, pastaciutta ?

--

Orpheus

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3EC35C77...@mich.com>, Raille <rai...@mich.com> writes:
>> - no vampire under 4 is allowed
>
>What? They didn't embrace or otherwise create prodigy in the Dark Ages??

This tends to be a result of equating capacity (in V:TES) with
generation (in V:tM). Which is a fair enough thing to do, though it has
problems. (The obvious one being "So why doesn't Arika create a 10
cap?")

However, if one does that, the Dark Ages tends to be higher up the
generation tree. If a 1 cap vampire is 15th generation, a 12th
generation (the lowest allowed in the last version of The Dark Ages I
saw) is 4 cap.

--
